description: Weekly grouped update PRs. Non-major PRs use GitHub auto-merge, so they merge once required checks pass; the rest wait for review.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes skip the schedule; group them because golang.org/x/* fixes bump each other

packageRules.description: Auto-merge every PR except major updates once required checks pass
Go modules (root and tools/) in one weekly update; majors get their own grouped PR
Go toolchain separately, so a failing upgrade doesn't hold back module updates
kinde-go drives provider behaviour and CI doesn't run acceptance tests, so review its updates by hand
GitHub Actions and the tools they install in one weekly update; majors get their own grouped PR
golangci-lint separately (set via GOLANGCI_LINT_VERSION in test.yml): new releases add checks that can fail CI
zizmor separately (action and the version it runs): new releases add audits that can fail CI
zizmor-action's version input takes a plain version (no digest), and ghcr.io has no release timestamps for the release-age wait
